info.title: Pidgey public API
info.description:
The public sending API of Pidgey (`/v1`). The version of this document is the version of the contract, not of the running service.

Every error answers the error envelope (`error.code`, `error.message`, optional `error.details` and `error.smtp`, `statusCode`, `timestamp`). Any path or method that is not described here answers `404` with code `NOT_FOUND` and the same error envelope (never `405`).

The `/v1` contract is additive-only: new optional request fields, new response fields and new error codes may be added; removing or renaming a field, changing a type or the meaning of a status or code, or making an optional field required needs a new major version (`/v2`). Clients must therefore ignore unknown response fields and handle unknown error codes by their HTTP status.

post.description:
Sends one email synchronously through the SMTP connection that is active for the organization of the token. The request body is limited to 1 MiB. `text` and `html` are optional individually, but at least one must be a non-empty string. An empty-string `text` or `html` counts as not sent.

With the optional `Idempotency-Key` header a caller can retry after losing the response without sending the message twice. The key is scoped to the organization and kept for 24 hours; a replayed answer is returned verbatim with the header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional key that makes a retry safe. 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters (a UUID fits). An invalid key answers `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`.

200.description: The message was accepted by the SMTP server.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: Present, with the value `true`, only when the answer is a replay of the stored answer of a previous request with the same `Idempotency-Key`.

get.description: Public: no token is needed and any credentials sent are ignored. Always JSON.

head.summary: Get the headers of this OpenAPI document
head.description: Same status and headers as `GET`, with an empty body.

200.description: The headers of the OpenAPI document; the body is empty.

bearerAuth.description: An API token sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, for example `pdg_example0123456789`. The token must carry the `send` scope; a valid token without it is refused with `403 FORBIDDEN`. A missing, malformed, unknown or revoked token is refused with `401 UNAUTHORIZED`.

subject.description: Plain text, UTF-8, at most 255 characters, without control characters.

text.description: Plain-text body. At least one of `text` and `html` must be a non-empty string.

html.description: HTML body. At least one of `text` and `html` must be a non-empty string.

SmtpReply.description: A reply of the SMTP server.

Error.description: The error envelope shared by every error answer.

code.description: Upper-case error code. New codes may be added, so clients must handle unknown codes by the HTTP status.

details.description: Validation errors only: one string per failed rule.

smtp.description: SMTP send failures only, when a reply of the SMTP server is available.

statusCode.description: The HTTP status, repeated in the body.

BadRequest.description: `BAD_REQUEST` for a malformed JSON body or a body that is not a JSON object, or `VALIDATION_FAILED` (with `error.details`) for an invalid payload (including a `subject` over 255 characters, neither `text` nor `html`, or an invalid `Idempotency-Key`).

Unauthorized.description: `UNAUTHORIZED`: the token is missing, malformed, unknown or revoked, or its organization has no approved user. The cause is never disclosed.

Forbidden.description: `FORBIDDEN`: the token lacks the `send` scope, or a cross-site browser request was rejected.

Conflict.description: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_USE`: a request with the same `Idempotency-Key` is still in progress. Or the SMTP connection must be fixed before sending: `NO_SMTP_CONNECTION` (the organization has no active SMTP connection), `SMTP_INSECURE_CREDENTIALS`, `SMTP_HOST_NOT_ALLOWED` or `SMTP_PASSWORD_UNREADABLE`.

error.message: The organization has no active SMTP connection

PayloadTooLarge.description: `HTTP_413`: the request body is over 1 MiB.

IdempotencyKeyReused.description: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`: the `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different payload.

SmtpBadGateway.description: The SMTP server failed or refused the message: `SMTP_CONNECTION_FAILED`, `SMTP_TLS_FAILED`, `SMTP_AUTH_FAILED`, `SMTP_REJECTED` or `SMTP_PROTOCOL_ERROR`. `error.smtp` carries the SMTP reply when one is available.

error.message: The SMTP server rejected the recipient

SmtpTemporaryFailure.description: `SMTP_TEMPORARY_FAILURE`: the SMTP server answered a 4xx reply; try again later.

SmtpTimeout.description: `SMTP_TIMEOUT`: the SMTP server timed out; delivery is unknown.
